headline: Georgian Court play on beyond the conference
dek: Georgian Court go to Millersville with twelve wins, more than any other programme in the conference. They have not lost since Jefferson beat them in October, and their last win came at Bridgeport, who had beaten them on their own ground earlier that month.
displaced_by: Georgian Court now have a match scheduled at Millersville, so the standing headline's 'finish the season' and the dek's 'closed the season' are no longer true

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals have not decided the table: Bridgeport have scored 49 and conceded 41, in a season of nine wins, three draws and eight defeats.

wire.line: Georgian Court still have a match to play, at Millersville, and have not lost since Jefferson beat them in October.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored eleven goals for Georgian Court from 81 shots, and has eight assists.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mathias Kristoffersen has kept nine shutouts for Felician and conceded twelve goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Goldey-Beacom have conceded 58 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dane Bodziak has scored eight goals for Chestnut Hill from eighteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made 103 saves for Holy Family and conceded 25 goals.

last_match.line: Bridgeport had won at Holy Family and at Wilmington on the way in.

next_match.line: Millersville beat Georgian Court without reply in September, and did the same to Holy Family on the opening day.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
